name: Margin used counts only a margin account's negative cash: a credit card's balance owed is a debt, not margin
spec: SPEC.md §6 Portfolio, Margin used: 'The negative cash balances of the open margin accounts in scope, one per currency, shown positive, converted to CAD … another account's negative balance (a credit card's balance owed) is a debt, not margin, and not counted'; subtitle 'Its share of the market value of every holding in the accounts in scope'
working: No filter: every account is in scope, M (margin, open) and K (credit card, open).
Margin account M: 80,000 deposited, 1,000 G bought at 100 (100,000); the broker states CAD cash −20,000.
Credit card K: the broker states CAD cash −5,380.56; K is not a margin account, so its negative balance is a debt and is not counted.
Margin used: the negative cash of the open margin accounts in scope, one per currency, shown positive, in CAD: M's CAD −20,000 → 20,000.00 (not 25,380.56).
Every holding in the accounts in scope: 1,000 G × 100 = 100,000 (K holds nothing).

name: A month's margin interest is each margin account's borrowing at its own rate, compounded daily over the month
spec: SPEC.md §7 Cashflow, cashflow-7: 'A month's margin interest at today's borrowing: each margin account in scope's borrowing in each currency at the yearly rate Wealthsimple states for it in that currency, compounded daily over this month's days as Wealthsimple works it out (borrowed × ((1 + rate ÷ the year's days) ^ the month's days − 1)), summed in CAD … waiting, named, while a rate is not read'
working: Margin account M borrows CAD 288,210 at a stated yearly rate of 0.0445; margin account N borrows CAD 10,000 at 0.0545 (every figure made up).
A month's margin interest: 1,091.27 + 46.39 = 1,137.66 (not 298,210 × one rate).

name: A month's margin interest waits, named, while a currency borrowed in has no rate read
spec: SPEC.md §7 Cashflow, cashflow-7: 'A month's margin interest at today's borrowing: each margin account in scope's borrowing in each currency at the yearly rate Wealthsimple states for it in that currency, compounded daily over this month's days as Wealthsimple works it out (borrowed × ((1 + rate ÷ the year's days) ^ the month's days − 1)), summed in CAD … waiting, named, while a rate is not read'
working: Margin account M borrows CAD 288,210 at 0.0445, and USD 1,000, for which Wealthsimple has stated no rate yet.
The USD part cannot be worked out, so the month's interest waits on M's USD rate: never the CAD part alone.
